title.zh: 编排视图：每轨一行，分轨片段首次可见
title.en: Arrangement view: one row per lane, so per-lane clips can be seen

highlights.zh: 编排面板新增每轨一行：显示该轨在每段播放哪个片段，以及它是否与段落默认不同。
highlights.en: The arrangement panel gains one row per lane, showing which clip each lane plays per section and when it differs from the section's own.

highlights.zh: 该能力在模型里已存在很久（SongSection.slots），此前在界面上完全不可见。
highlights.en: The capability has been in the model for a long time (SongSection.slots) and was invisible in the UI until now.

highlights.zh: 只读视图，不改动音频，包体不变。
highlights.en: A read-only view: audio is untouched and the bundle budget is unchanged.

title.en: Fast previews, and a lyric bound to its notes

highlights.zh: render_preview_clip：一段 14.4 秒音频 1.45 秒渲完，调试不必每次重跑全曲。
highlights.en: render_preview_clip: 14.4 s of audio in 1.45 s, so a composing loop stops re-rendering the whole piece.

highlights.zh: set_vocal_melody：音节与音高同索引绑定，写入即检查倒字；声调由你提供，工具从不猜拼音。
highlights.en: set_vocal_melody: syllables bound at the same index as their pitch, checked as written; tones are yours, never guessed.

highlights.zh: 响度工具改为按需迭代：一次调用一次渲染，不再撞上 30 秒的客户端超时。
highlights.en: The loudness loop is opt-in: one render per call, so it no longer meets a client's 30 s timeout.

title.zh: 段落独立片段与响度闭环
title.en: Per-section clips, and a loudness loop that reports its limits

highlights.zh: make_unique：槽位是歌曲级的，此工具把某段落的片段复制到空槽并只重指该段，三段主歌终于能各有旋律。
highlights.en: make_unique: a slot is song-global, so this copies one section's clip into a free slot and repoints only that section.

highlights.zh: normalize_loudness：测量再渲染再测量，并如实报告三种结局——达标、被峰值上限挡住、或被主限制器持有。
highlights.en: normalize_loudness: measure, render, measure, and report three honest outcomes — target, peak ceiling, or held by the master limiter.

highlights.zh: 修了探针里从未被打印的检查：此前它的 ✅/❌ 一直是静默的。
highlights.en: Fixed the probe's checks, which had never been printed — its pass/fail had been silent all along.

title.zh: 修复：旋律越界与和声 op 被拒
title.en: Fixes: a melody that overran its pattern, and a harmony op the schema rejected

highlights.zh: generate_melody bars=4 曾返回 96 步（应为 64），负长度切片把幽灵乐句追加到尾部。
highlights.en: generate_melody with bars=4 returned 96 steps instead of 64: a negative slice length appended ghost phrases.

highlights.zh: set_chord_progression 进入运行时 schema —— 此前实现与文档都推荐它，校验却直接打回。
highlights.en: set_chord_progression is now in the runtime schema; the docs recommended it while validation rejected it.

title.zh: 实时对齐：把引擎里存了却从未使用的补偿接上
title.en: Realtime alignment: connecting the compensation the engine stored but never used

highlights.zh: 现场播放与离线导出现在重新对齐；此前离线已补偿、实时的 3 ms 补偿无人读取。
highlights.en: Live playback and the offline bounce agree again: offline was compensated, and the realtime 3 ms was read by nothing.

highlights.zh: 传输起点按限幅器延迟提前调度，用户设过的值优先，且减法以 35 ms 安全余量为界。
highlights.en: The transport schedules earlier by the limiter's latency, a user value wins, and the subtraction is bounded by the 35 ms margin.

title.zh: 导出对齐（PDC）：补偿限幅器前瞻延迟
title.en: Export alignment (PDC): compensating the limiter's lookahead

highlights.zh: 导出的每一次渲染此前都带着 3 ms 偏移，因为延迟被声明、被显示、却从未被施加。
highlights.en: Every exported render carried a 3 ms shift: the latency was declared, displayed, and never applied.

highlights.zh: 现在两条路径都按 limiter 前瞻裁剪对齐，长度与事件位置不变；预测 7.408 ms，实测 7.415 ms。
highlights.en: Both paths are now trimmed by the limiter's lookahead, keeping length and event positions; predicted 7.408 ms, measured 7.415 ms.

highlights.zh: 音色与响度基线均守住（±0.35 dB 内），无需重录。
highlights.en: The timbre and loudness baselines held (within ±0.35 dB), so no re-record was needed.

title.zh: MCP 范例库：按曲风的可模仿配方 + few-shot 提示
title.en: MCP example library: imitable recipes per genre, plus a few-shot prompt

highlights.zh: get_example 与 groove://examples/{genre}：每个范例自带产生它的工具调用序列。
highlights.en: get_example and groove://examples/{genre}: each example carries the tool calls that produced it.

highlights.zh: 范例由曲风库构建而非粘贴，因此不会随曲风变化而漂移，且都通过 validate_pattern。
highlights.en: Examples are built from the genre library rather than pasted, so they cannot drift, and every one passes validate_pattern.

highlights.zh: 新增 compose_with_examples 提示：先读配方再动手，并提醒 undo_song 让实验不必永久。
highlights.en: New compose_with_examples prompt: read a recipe before writing, and undo_song so an experiment need not be permanent.

title.zh: MCP 新增：撤销、和声、旋律与声调检查
title.en: MCP gains undo, harmony, melody and a prosody check

highlights.zh: undo_song：每次改动都有 opId，get_song 列出可回退的历史。
highlights.en: undo_song: every change carries an opId, and get_song lists what is undoable.

highlights.zh: set_chord_progression / suggest_progression：按情绪挑选进行并渲染到指定调。
highlights.en: set_chord_progression and suggest_progression: choose a progression by emotion and render it in a key.

highlights.zh: generate_melody（轮廓优先、AABA、音域受限）与 validate_prosody（倒字只警告）。
highlights.en: generate_melody (contour-first, AABA, range-bounded) and validate_prosody (倒字, advisory).

title.zh: 四槽编辑器上线；修 MCP 的 clips 与时长估计；包格式规范
title.en: Four-slot editor; MCP clips and duration fixes; the package format spec

highlights.zh: 编辑器槽位与复制控件支持 A–D，切到空槽会创建并保留，工程保存也带上它们。
highlights.en: The editor's slot and copy controls cover A–D; switching to an empty slot creates and keeps it, and saving carries them.

highlights.zh: 修复 create_song 的 clips 只传部分槽位被拒、secondsEstimate 低估四倍、导出文件名的中文塌陷。
highlights.en: Fixed create_song refusing a partial clips object, secondsEstimate reading four times low, and Chinese titles collapsing in file names.

highlights.zh: 新增 .groove 包格式规范（校验规则与版本兼容承诺），并记录 A4 的纹理轨测量结论。
highlights.en: Added the .groove package specification with its validation rules and compatibility commitment, and recorded A4's texture-lane measurement.

title.zh: 编辑器支持四个 clip 槽位；MCP 两处修复
title.en: The editor holds four clip slots; two MCP fixes

highlights.zh: 槽位控件与复制控件支持 A–D，切到空槽会自动创建并保留。
highlights.en: The slot and copy controls work across A–D; switching to an empty slot creates and keeps it.

highlights.zh: 修复 create_song 的 clips 只传部分槽位会被拒，以及 secondsEstimate 低估四倍。
highlights.en: Fixed create_song refusing a partial clips object, and secondsEstimate reading four times too low.

highlights.zh: 新增 .groove 包格式规范文档（含版本兼容承诺）。
highlights.en: Added the .groove package format specification, with its compatibility commitment.
